settings.title: Protein
settings.text: Gelatin is almost pure protein, with no fat and no carbohydrates. Pectin and starch are carbohydrates.

settings.title: Collagen amino acids
settings.text: About half of gelatin's amino acids are glycine, proline and hydroxyproline, the building blocks of collagen.

settings.title: Sugar to set pectin
settings.text: Classic pectin won't set until the mix is more than 55% dissolved solids, which mostly means sugar. Gelatin sets on its own.

settings.title: Melting point
settings.text: Gelatin melts below body temperature, so every cube softens as you chew, a quality pectin and starch can't quite match.

settings.label: Sugar needed to set
settings.theirs: Classic pectin needs a mix over 55% dissolved solids

settings.label: Amino acids
settings.ours: Rich in glycine, proline and hydroxyproline

settings.label: The bite
settings.ours: Dense, elastic chew that melts in the mouth

settings.question: What makes Reserve different?
settings.answer:
It starts with the formula. Every active is chosen for its human research and included at the dose those studies used, with nothing hidden in a proprietary blend.

Each formula is set in 100% grass-fed beef gelatin, made in a cGMP-certified facility in the USA, and independently third-party tested.

settings.question: Can I trust your products?
settings.answer: Yes. Every ingredient and every dose is printed on the label, so you always know exactly what you're taking. Our formulas are made in a cGMP-certified facility in the USA and independently third-party tested for purity, consistency and quality.

settings.question: How long does it take to work?
settings.answer: Consistency matters most. Many of the studies behind our ingredients ran for 4 to 12 weeks of daily use, so we recommend taking Reserve every day and giving it at least a few weeks.

settings.question: What's the difference between Cognition and Vitality?
settings.answer:
• Cognition is our daily formula for focus, memory and calm, built around Magtein®, citicoline, L-theanine and B vitamins.
  • Vitality is our next formula, now in development, built for daily energy and vitality. We'll share the full formula before launch.

settings.question: Can I take Reserve with other supplements?
settings.answer: Our formulas are made for daily use. If you take other supplements or any medication, check with your healthcare provider first, especially for nutrients that may overlap, like magnesium and B vitamins.

settings.question: Is it safe to take Reserve while pregnant or breastfeeding?
settings.answer: Please talk with your healthcare provider before taking any supplement while pregnant or breastfeeding.

settings.question: Will Cognition make me tired or jittery?
settings.answer: Cognition is caffeine-free and contains no stimulants. It pairs L-theanine with the other actives for calm, steady focus, and it isn't designed to make you drowsy.

settings.question: How do I manage my subscription?
settings.answer: Log in to your account to change your delivery date, skip a shipment, or update your payment and shipping details.

settings.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
settings.answer: Log in to your account, open your subscription, and follow the steps to cancel. If you need a hand, contact us and we'll take care of it.

settings.question: How do I contact customer service?
settings.answer: Send us a note through our contact page and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

settings.hero_text:
Your brain and body don't run on separate systems. The nutrients you're missing, the sleep you're not getting and the stress you carry all feed into one another, and a gap in one can show up in the others: slower focus, flatter energy, a shorter fuse and restless nights.

These gaps are more common than most people think. About 1 in 3 American adults don't get enough sleep, nearly half of Americans get less magnesium from food than they need, and most fall short on choline, a nutrient the brain uses to make acetylcholine. Reserve formulas are built to help close those gaps, with research-backed nutrients at full doses in a gummy made from real food.
settings.hero_sources: Sources: CDC, 2016; NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Magnesium; NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Choline.
settings.base_text:
Most gummy supplements start with sugar. Sugar and glucose syrup often lead the ingredient list, set with pectin or starch: carbohydrates that add bulk and sweetness, and little else.

We started with something older and better: 100% grass-fed beef gelatin. It's one of the oldest prepared foods on record. Today it's the primal base that gives every Reserve cube its dense, satisfying chew.
settings.base_vs_title: Gelatin versus the typical gummy base.
settings.base_grass_text:
Gelatin is only as good as where it comes from. We use gelatin from grass-fed cattle because the source matters to us as much as the formula, and it's the same standard we hold everything in the jar to: know exactly where it comes from, and choose the best version of it.

No pectin, no starch, and no shortcuts in the base. Just 100% grass-fed beef gelatin, the way gummies were meant to be made.
settings.base_sources: Sources: Gelatin Manufacturers Institute of America, Gelatin Handbook; Rousselot, What is gelatin made of?; Food Additives, Pectin; Prepared Foods, Gelatin and its Hydrocolloid Alternatives, 2011; Gelatin, history.

settings.results_text: We started Reserve Nutrition to make supplements people can actually trust: formulas grounded in human research, dosed to match it, and good enough to look forward to every day.
